description: Altri temi - Suolo e vegetazione - SIN - Siti Interesse Nazionale - SIN-Porto Torres - Cartografie is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sardegnasira.it. La cartografia contiene i perimetri relativi al Sito di Interesse Nazionale relativo all'area industriale di Porto Torres. Coverage: IT. Its keywords include n.d., Soil. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2020-04-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
